soft_deny: Running SQL directly against the live Supabase project (via psql, the Supabase SQL editor API, a service-role script, or any other path) that creates, alters, or drops a table, trigger, function, policy, or index — migrations in supabase/migrations/ are written for the user to run by hand, never executed automatically

Deleting or bulk-modifying rows in the live Supabase database (including via service-role/admin scripts), except for cleaning up disposable test fixtures (e.g. test accounts/properties/signs) created earlier in the same session
git push --force or force-pushing any branch
Modifying production or CI/CD configuration (vercel.json, .github/workflows/**, .env.production, or any live deployment settings)
